title: Finish the Pattern · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Finish the Pattern · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a two-sound pattern, such as clap then tap. A partner performs the pattern twice, then the lead performs the next two sounds. The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Finish the Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly.
